results.title: EFCC arrests 14 Chinese nationals, one Nigerian over four illegal lithium processing plants
results.snippet:
The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) has arrested 15 people comprised of 14 Chinese nationals and a Nigerian, over alleged illegal lithium-processing operations at four plants in Ogere, Ogun State.
